spatial_scope: One or more retained USGS NAS occurrence records explicitly name Douglas County, Georgia. This does not imply current countywide distribution or abundance.
caveats: USGS NAS records are provisional and vary in accuracy, scale, completeness, population status, and temporal currency.
The assertion aggregates qualifying occurrence rows for one county-species pair and preserves every raw row in the immutable archive.
Archive silence never supports absence or non-detection.
Coordinates were retained as lineage but were not used to determine a county equivalent.
